text:
A casual visitor to Chiang Mai.
This year I haven't used my social security benefits at a dental clinic yet because it's almost the end of the year. So I wanted to get my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). I searched for dental clinics in Chiang Mai and ended up at Groove Dental Clinic based on reviews. *I wasn't disappointed!* From the moment I stepped into the clinic, two female receptionists were smiling, cheerful, and very friendly. 🤗 I had my teeth cleaned by Dr. Chutima (I found out her name later), who was incredibly gentle. Picking my teeth hurt more than this! 555 I highly recommend this clinic. If you've had painful or sensitive teeth cleaning elsewhere, try this place. I'll definitely use their services again next time I visit Chiang Mai. 5 stars!
I get my dental work done here every year. The dentist is very gentle. If there's a problem with my teeth, the doctor fixes it for free. I'm very impressed with this place.

I highly recommend this place for anyone who's afraid of pain at the dentist. I can honestly say it wasn't painful at all! The dentist was so kind during the wisdom tooth extraction, and it only took a short time, which surprised me. It was amazing! This is the place to get your wisdom tooth extracted.
This is my second visit, and the tooth extraction was excellent. My fear of pain completely disappeared. If you're looking for a clinic with painless tooth extractions, I highly recommend this one.

The place is clean, the service is good, the doctor is kind, gentle, the staff are polite, the price is not too expensive. I used the service from tooth extraction, wisdom tooth extraction, and tooth filling. I am very impressed.

At first, I couldn't believe that an anesthetic injection could be painless. Today, I had two wisdom teeth extracted at once, and I was impressed from the moment I arrived. The staff were so polite and cheerful (actually, everyone was incredibly friendly!).

The main point is that the anesthetic injection at this clinic was incredibly painless – the least painful I've ever experienced (it's impossible to be completely painless 😅). The dentist was incredibly gentle, and importantly, they chatted with me throughout the procedure. It really made me feel more comfortable.

Plus, the price is very affordable, with many discounts and promotions available. If you're still hesitant, give it a try! ☺️

My husband wanted teeth whitening, so we made an appointment here while passing by.
We made an appointment for 1:30 PM on Tuesday.

The clinic was very clean, and the staff was very friendly.
Best of all, the doctor spoke English well, so communication was seamless.
My husband needed to remove tartar before getting his teeth whitened, so we also had a scaling procedure.
The doctor whitened his teeth three times over a two-hour period, resulting in perfect whitening.
The cost was also cheaper than in Korea.

My husband was very satisfied.
If you need a dentist in Chiang Mai, I highly recommend this place.
